test_groupby_with_timegrouper: test grouping a series by time periods using Grouper with frequency and label parameters
test_resample_count_aggregation: test counting non-NaN values per time period using resample with Grouper and groupby
test_resample_numpy_reduction: test applying numpy reduction functions like prod via resample against groupby baseline
test_apply_iteration_grouped: test applying a function across time-grouped DataFrame rows and verifying index alignment
test_fails_on_no_datetime_index: test that Grouper raises TypeError when used with non-datetime index types
test_aggregate_normal_method: test that TimeGrouper aggregation results match normal groupby for sum, mean, count methods
test_aggregate_with_nat_values: test TimeGrouper aggregation behavior when the grouping key contains NaT values
test_resample_entirely_nat_window: test resample aggregation on windows that are entirely NaN or NaT values
test_upsample_sum_aggregation: test upsampling a series and summing values across finer-grained time intervals
test_groupby_resample_interpolate_raises: test that direct groupby-then-resample interpolation raises NotImplementedError
test_groupby_resample_interpolate_with_a: test groupby-then-resample interpolation using apply syntax with linear interpolation
test_groupby_resample_interpolate_off_gr: test groupby-then-resample interpolation with non-standard resampling intervals
test_timegrouper_repr: test the string representation of Grouper with default and custom origin parameters
test_group_order_stability: test that TimeGrouper produces stable, sorted group ordering for datetime keys
